recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-23870 unless a future work group decision changes the Device.deviceVersion model or asks for broader narrative guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-23870 was a Published FHIR-core Device change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested clarifying Device.version.component as the hardware or software module of the device to which a version applies and adding a note that such a module need not be tracked as a separate Device, for example when one device includes multiple software modules on different versions.
initial_application: Commit a7f2575daae7bbacd9a22ea439c7ec35a4784f96 listed FHIR-23870 as pre-applied and changed source/device/device-spreadsheet.xml from generic component wording to the approved hardware/software module definition and note. Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 later moved that content into the current source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml format.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. The current model uses Device.deviceVersion.component rather than the older Device.version.component name, and the active StructureDefinition already contains the requested definition and comment. OO minutes from 2019-10-31 confirm the FHIR-23870 block-vote disposition. A later Zulip Device.version thread is consistent with the wording, and FHIR-32566 is a same-area uniqueness-guidance issue already represented on the combined branch without superseding this clarification.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current authoritative source already satisfies the final Jira request, and adding extra narrative would duplicate existing conformance text rather than fix a semantic gap.
